markdown.markdown: ```{r} #| label: setup #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false library(highcharter) library(knitr) library(kableExtra) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) ``` Una función $f(x)$ mapea elementos de un conjunto de entrada hacia un conjunto de salida. * **Dominio:** Es el conjunto de entrada (los valores que puede tomar $x$). * **Rango:** Es el conjunto de salida (los valores resultantes de $y$ o $f(x)$). Por ejemplo, si tenemos $f(x) = x + 4$, al evaluar $a$, obtenemos $f(a) = a + 4$. **Todas las funciones se pueden graficar.** --- Las funciones se dividen en dos grandes familias: algebraicas y trascendentes. ### Funciones Algebraicas ::: panel-tabset ### Constante $f(x) = k$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = 3$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-5, 5)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) 3, color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1.2) + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Lineal $f(x) = mx + b$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = 2x + 1$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-5, 5)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) 2*x + 1, color = "#27AE60", linewidth = 1.2) + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Cuadrática $f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = x^2 - 4$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-4, 4)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) x^2 - 4, color = "#E67E22", linewidth = 1.2) + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Polinómica $f(x) = a_n x^n + \dots + a_0$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = x^3 - 4x$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-3, 3)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) x^3 - 4*x, color = "#8E44AD", linewidth = 1.2) + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Racional $f(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 #| warning: false x_rat <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 400) y_rat <- 1 / x_rat y_rat[abs(x_rat) < 0.1] <- NA ggplot(data.frame(x = x_rat, y = y_rat), aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_line(color = "#C0392B", linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-10, 10)) + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Radical $f(x) = \sqrt[n]{P(x)}$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = \sqrt{x}$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(0, 10)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) sqrt(x), color = "#16A085", linewidth = 1.2) + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ::: ### Funciones Trascendentes ::: panel-tabset ### Exponencial $f(x) = a^x$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = e^x$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-3, 3)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) exp(x), color = "#D35400", linewidth = 1.2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Logarítmica $f(x) = \log_a(x)$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = \ln(x)$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 #| warning: false ggplot(data.frame(x = c(0.01, 10)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) log(x), color = "#27AE60", linewidth = 1.2) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)") ``` ### Trigonométricas $f(x) = \sin(x), \cos(x), \tan(x)$ **Ejemplo:** $f(x) = \sin(x)$ ```{r} #| echo: false #| fig-height: 3.5 #| fig-width: 5 ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-2*pi, 2*pi)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) sin(x), color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1.2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray80") + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x (radianes)", y = "f(x)") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-2*pi, -pi, 0, pi, 2*pi), labels = c("-2π", "-π", "0", "π", "2π")) ``` ::: ## Propiedades de las Funciones Al analizar la gráfica de una función, podemos identificar las siguientes propiedades: 1. Concavidad 2. Acotación 3. Periodicidad 4. Asíntotas --- ## Ejemplos de funciones ### 1. $f(x) = x^2 - 4$ * **Dominio:** $x \in \mathbb{R}$ o $(-\infty, \infty)$ * **Rango:** $\{y \in \mathbb{R} \mid y \ge -4\}$ o $[-4, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -3:3 y_vals <- x_vals^2 - 4 df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-4, 4, by = 0.1) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(x_hc^2 - 4, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#2980B9", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)")) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 2. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x+3}$ * **Dominio:** $\{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x \neq -3\}$ o $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-3, \infty)$ * **Rango:** $\{y \in \mathbb{R} \mid y \neq 0\}$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -6:0 y_vals <- round(1 / (x_vals + 3), 2) y_vals[is.infinite(y_vals)] <- "Indefinido" df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-8, 2, by = 0.05) y_hc <- 1 / (x_hc + 3) y_hc[abs(x_hc + 3) < 0.1] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#8E44AD", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -10, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 3. $f(x) = \sqrt{9-x^2}$ * **Dominio:** $9-x^2 \ge 0 \implies (3-x)(3+x) \ge 0 \implies -3 \le x \le 3$. Dominio: $[-3, 3]$ * **Rango:** $[0, 3]$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -4:4 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(sqrt(9 - x_vals^2)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.nan(y_vals), "No Real", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-3, 3, by = 0.05) y_hc <- sqrt(9 - x_hc^2) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#27AE60", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_plotOptions(line = list(lineWidth = 3)) %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = 0, max = 4) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 4. $f(x) = |x-2|$ * **Dominio:** $x \in \mathbb{R}$ * **Rango:** $\{y \in \mathbb{R} \mid y \ge 0\}$ o $[0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -1:5 y_vals <- abs(x_vals - 2) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-2, 6, by = 0.1) y_hc <- abs(x_hc - 2) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = y_hc) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#E67E22", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)")) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 5. $f(x) = \sqrt{5-x}$ * **Dominio:** $5-x \ge 0 \implies x \le 5$. Dominio: $(-\infty, 5]$ * **Rango:** $[0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- 1:7 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(sqrt(5 - x_vals)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.nan(y_vals), "No Real", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-5, 5, by = 0.05) y_hc <- sqrt(5 - x_hc) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#16A085", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_plotOptions(line = list(lineWidth = 3)) %>% # <--- Línea agregada hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)")) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 6. $f(x) = \frac{x}{|x|}$ * **Dominio:** $x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x \neq 0$ * **Rango:** $\{-1, 1\}$ (Es 1 si $x > 0$, y -1 si $x < 0$) ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -3:3 y_vals <- x_vals / abs(x_vals) y_vals[is.nan(y_vals)] <- "Indefinido" df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-5, 5, by = 0.05) y_hc <- x_hc / abs(x_hc) y_hc[abs(x_hc) < 0.1] <- NA # Romper línea en el salto df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#2C3E50", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -2, max = 2) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: ### 7. $f(x) = \frac{2x}{x^2 - 9}$ * **Dominio:** El denominador se hace cero cuando $x^2 - 9 = 0$, es decir, en $x = 3$ y $x = -3$. * $D_f = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{-3, 3\}$ o $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-3, 3) \cup (3, \infty)$ * **Rango:** La función cruza el eje horizontal y cubre todos los valores reales. * $R_f = \mathbb{R}$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -5:5 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(2 * x_vals / (x_vals^2 - 9)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.infinite(y_vals), "Indefinido", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(c(3, 9), bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-8, 8, by = 0.05) y_hc <- (2 * x_hc) / (x_hc^2 - 9) # Cortar la línea en las asíntotas y_hc[abs(x_hc - 3) < 0.1 | abs(x_hc + 3) < 0.1] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#C0392B", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -10, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 8. $f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4}$ * **Dominio:** $x^2 - 4 \ge 0 \implies (x-2)(x+2) \ge 0$. Esto ocurre en los extremos exteriores de las raíces. * $D_f = (-\infty, -2] \cup [2, \infty)$ * **Rango:** Como es una raíz principal par, sus valores son no negativos. * $R_f = [0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -4:4 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(sqrt(x_vals^2 - 4)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.nan(y_vals), "No Real", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4:6, color = "#7F8C8D", italic = TRUE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-6, 6, by = 0.05) y_hc <- sqrt(x_hc^2 - 4) y_hc[x_hc > -2 & x_hc < 2] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#D35400", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_plotOptions(line = list(lineWidth = 3)) %>% # <--- Línea agregada hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = 0, max = 6) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 9. $f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}$ * **Dominio:** El argumento de la raíz debe ser positivo y, al estar en el denominador, no puede ser cero. * $D_f = (0, \infty)$ * **Rango:** El numerador es una constante positiva y la raíz siempre da valores positivos, por lo que nunca toca el cero ni los negativos. * $R_f = (0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- 0:5 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(1 / sqrt(x_vals)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.infinite(y_vals), "Asíntota", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false # Iniciamos en un valor apenas mayor a cero x_hc <- seq(0.01, 8, by = 0.05) y_hc <- 1 / sqrt(x_hc) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#2980B9", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = 0, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 10. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x+3}$ * **Dominio:** El denominador no puede ser cero. * $D_f = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{-3\}$ o $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-3, \infty)$ * **Rango:** Como el numerador nunca es cero, $f(x)$ nunca vale cero. * $R_f = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0\}$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -6:0 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(1 / (x_vals + 3)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.infinite(y_vals), "Indefinido", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-8, 2, by = 0.05) y_hc <- 1 / (x_hc + 3) y_hc[abs(x_hc + 3) < 0.1] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#8E44AD", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -10, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` :::

ggplot(data.frame(x = c(-2*pi, 2*pi)), aes(x = x)) + stat_function(fun = function(x) sin(x), color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1.2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray80") + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "x (radianes)", y = "f(x)") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-2*pi, -pi, 0, pi, 2*pi), labels = c("-2π", "-π", "0", "π", "2π")) ``` ::: ## Propiedades de las Funciones Al analizar la gráfica de una función, podemos identificar las siguientes propiedades: 1. Concavidad 2. Acotación 3. Periodicidad 4. Asíntotas --- ## Ejemplos de funciones ### 1. $f(x) = x^2 - 4$ * **Dominio:** $x \in \mathbb{R}$ o $(-\infty, \infty)$ * **Rango:** $\{y \in \mathbb{R} \mid y \ge -4\}$ o $[-4, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -3:3 y_vals <- x_vals^2 - 4 df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-4, 4, by = 0.1) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(x_hc^2 - 4, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#2980B9", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)")) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 2. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x+3}$ * **Dominio:** $\{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x \neq -3\}$ o $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-3, \infty)$ * **Rango:** $\{y \in \mathbb{R} \mid y \neq 0\}$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -6:0 y_vals <- round(1 / (x_vals + 3), 2) y_vals[is.infinite(y_vals)] <- "Indefinido" df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-8, 2, by = 0.05) y_hc <- 1 / (x_hc + 3) y_hc[abs(x_hc + 3) < 0.1] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#8E44AD", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -10, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 3. $f(x) = \sqrt{9-x^2}$ * **Dominio:** $9-x^2 \ge 0 \implies (3-x)(3+x) \ge 0 \implies -3 \le x \le 3$. Dominio: $[-3, 3]$ * **Rango:** $[0, 3]$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -4:4 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(sqrt(9 - x_vals^2)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.nan(y_vals), "No Real", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-3, 3, by = 0.05) y_hc <- sqrt(9 - x_hc^2) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#27AE60", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_plotOptions(line = list(lineWidth = 3)) %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = 0, max = 4) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 4. $f(x) = |x-2|$ * **Dominio:** $x \in \mathbb{R}$ * **Rango:** $\{y \in \mathbb{R} \mid y \ge 0\}$ o $[0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -1:5 y_vals <- abs(x_vals - 2) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-2, 6, by = 0.1) y_hc <- abs(x_hc - 2) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = y_hc) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#E67E22", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)")) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 5. $f(x) = \sqrt{5-x}$ * **Dominio:** $5-x \ge 0 \implies x \le 5$. Dominio: $(-\infty, 5]$ * **Rango:** $[0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- 1:7 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(sqrt(5 - x_vals)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.nan(y_vals), "No Real", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-5, 5, by = 0.05) y_hc <- sqrt(5 - x_hc) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#16A085", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_plotOptions(line = list(lineWidth = 3)) %>% # <--- Línea agregada hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)")) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 6. $f(x) = \frac{x}{|x|}$ * **Dominio:** $x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x \neq 0$ * **Rango:** $\{-1, 1\}$ (Es 1 si $x > 0$, y -1 si $x < 0$) ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -3:3 y_vals <- x_vals / abs(x_vals) y_vals[is.nan(y_vals)] <- "Indefinido" df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-5, 5, by = 0.05) y_hc <- x_hc / abs(x_hc) y_hc[abs(x_hc) < 0.1] <- NA # Romper línea en el salto df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#2C3E50", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -2, max = 2) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: ### 7. $f(x) = \frac{2x}{x^2 - 9}$ * **Dominio:** El denominador se hace cero cuando $x^2 - 9 = 0$, es decir, en $x = 3$ y $x = -3$. * $D_f = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{-3, 3\}$ o $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-3, 3) \cup (3, \infty)$ * **Rango:** La función cruza el eje horizontal y cubre todos los valores reales. * $R_f = \mathbb{R}$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -5:5 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(2 * x_vals / (x_vals^2 - 9)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.infinite(y_vals), "Indefinido", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(c(3, 9), bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-8, 8, by = 0.05) y_hc <- (2 * x_hc) / (x_hc^2 - 9) # Cortar la línea en las asíntotas y_hc[abs(x_hc - 3) < 0.1 | abs(x_hc + 3) < 0.1] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#C0392B", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -10, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 8. $f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4}$ * **Dominio:** $x^2 - 4 \ge 0 \implies (x-2)(x+2) \ge 0$. Esto ocurre en los extremos exteriores de las raíces. * $D_f = (-\infty, -2] \cup [2, \infty)$ * **Rango:** Como es una raíz principal par, sus valores son no negativos. * $R_f = [0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -4:4 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(sqrt(x_vals^2 - 4)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.nan(y_vals), "No Real", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4:6, color = "#7F8C8D", italic = TRUE) ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-6, 6, by = 0.05) y_hc <- sqrt(x_hc^2 - 4) y_hc[x_hc > -2 & x_hc < 2] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#D35400", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_plotOptions(line = list(lineWidth = 3)) %>% # <--- Línea agregada hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = 0, max = 6) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 9. $f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}$ * **Dominio:** El argumento de la raíz debe ser positivo y, al estar en el denominador, no puede ser cero. * $D_f = (0, \infty)$ * **Rango:** El numerador es una constante positiva y la raíz siempre da valores positivos, por lo que nunca toca el cero ni los negativos. * $R_f = (0, \infty)$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- 0:5 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(1 / sqrt(x_vals)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.infinite(y_vals), "Asíntota", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false # Iniciamos en un valor apenas mayor a cero x_hc <- seq(0.01, 8, by = 0.05) y_hc <- 1 / sqrt(x_hc) df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#2980B9", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = 0, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` ::: --- ### 10. $f(x) = \frac{1}{x+3}$ * **Dominio:** El denominador no puede ser cero. * $D_f = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{-3\}$ o $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-3, \infty)$ * **Rango:** Como el numerador nunca es cero, $f(x)$ nunca vale cero. * $R_f = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0\}$ ::: {layout-ncol=2 style="display: flex; align-items: center;"} ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_vals <- -6:0 y_vals <- suppressWarnings(1 / (x_vals + 3)) y_vals <- ifelse(is.infinite(y_vals), "Indefinido", round(y_vals, 2)) df_tbl <- data.frame(x = x_vals, `f(x)` = y_vals, check.names = FALSE) kable(df_tbl, align = "c") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#E74C3C") ``` ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false x_hc <- seq(-8, 2, by = 0.05) y_hc <- 1 / (x_hc + 3) y_hc[abs(x_hc + 3) < 0.1] <- NA df_hc <- data.frame(x = round(x_hc, 2), y = round(y_hc, 2)) hchart(df_hc, "line", hcaes(x = x, y = y), color = "#8E44AD", name = "f(x)") %>% hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "x"), crosshair = TRUE) %>% hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "f(x)"), min = -10, max = 10) %>% hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "f(x): {point.y}") ``` :::
